title: The title field is required.
slug: The slug field must only contain letters, numbers, dashes, and underscores.
body: The body field must be a string.
locale: The locale field must not be greater than 10 characters.
translation_group: The translation group field must not be greater than 64 characters.
categories: The categories field must be an array.
is_index: The is index field must be true or false.
